layouts.name: Bangsaen Street Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The municipal 2012 event map identifies the Laem Thaen coastal bulb, the southern return on Soi Bangsaen–Ang Sila 1, the Ang Sila straight and the short northern switchback. The route excludes the longer southern beach-road excursion, the northern headland loop and inner residential shortcuts. Exact current public road nodes give 3779.8 m compared with the supplied 3761 m; the organizer separately describes 3740 m. Current roundabout arcs and the northern road junction may differ from temporary race barriers, so the trace remains a street-centreline draft rather than a surveyed event racing line. The municipal map supports configuration identity only; no imagery coordinates are traced. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3779.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
